verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes a usage-based pricing model with documented MAR tiers and a public pricing page (fivetran-docs-9, -21, -27, -52), which lets a buyer estimate cost in principle. However, multiple hands-on community reports directly contradict the 'predictable' framing: users report 'active row based pricing is unpredictable and can have huge spikes in billing costs' (fivetran-comm-3), a case where Fivetran 'inflated your data and then bill you for it' by 10x via an unexpected join (fivetran-comm-9), and warnings that costs 'get expensive quickly' and require active row-count management post-hoc rather than pre-connection estimation (fivetran-comm-12, fivetran-comm-13). Missing for 10: a pre-connection cost calculator/estimator tool, first-party guidance for predicting MAR before connecting a specific source, and resolution of the documented spike/inflation issues.
